audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was credited to Locke in both layers on the claim that you simply dash out of her ult. You cannot — Leap of Faith grounds.
audit.why: packet.levelChart index 4 = Skill and the mirror audit already set that row to Skill at 5/10.
audit.corrected: win[4] and phases[4].side set to Skill, rating 5/10, as a matched pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was built entirely on escaping her ult with Ashen Pursuit, so the page's central mid-game plan was the one thing the ult prevents.
audit.why: Illaoi R carries the grounding flag, 450 range, 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, late and wants.you[2] rewritten around leaving the radius before the slam instead of dashing out after it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slots are swapped: the page writes 'Tentacle Smash (W)' and 'Harsh Lesson (E)'. Tentacle Smash is Q, Harsh Lesson is W (a 4s leap that makes every nearby tentacle swing at the target), and E is Test of Spirit.
audit.why: Kit slots: Q Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6s, W Harsh Lesson 4s, E Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range.
audit.corrected: Corrected in spikes[0].text and early, with the 4s Harsh Lesson cooldown stated — that short number is why her tentacle damage is relentless.

audit.whatIsWrong: Leap of Faith grounding was absent everywhere, and the page actively told you to dash out of it. Her passive healing off tentacle hits was described only vaguely as 'sustain', with no anti-heal call.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.' Kit R flags: grounding, untargetable, zone.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into spikes[1].text, mid, late and wants.you[2]; Grievous Wounds named in early.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Leaps of Faith' and 'Her Leap of Faith' — the second is a false positive; the first was pluralised prose and is gone with the rewrite.

edits.before: Level 5 is even until your ult comes online.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — her R grounds your escape.

edits.before: At 6 you're favoured — E escapes her R and Purgatory executes her.
edits.after: First item favours you — burst her between the tentacle swings.

edits.before: Never fight Illaoi in her tentacles — Tentacle Smash (W) plus Harsh Lesson (E) rip a spirit out of you and she out-sustains any prolonged trade, so dodge Test of Spirit (E) and trade only when tentacles are down.
edits.after: Never fight Illaoi in her tentacles — Tentacle Smash (Q) buffs them and Harsh Lesson (W, 4s) makes every one nearby swing at you, and each hit heals her, so dodge Test of Spirit (E, 16s) and trade off the tentacles.

edits.before: Purgatory (R) is your answer to her all-in — if she Leaps of Faith (R) onto you, E out with Ashen Pursuit, then re-engage and execute her under the threshold once her tentacle wall expires.
edits.after: Purgatory (R) answers her all-in, but Leap of Faith grounds you inside it — leave the 450 radius before the slam, then re-engage and execute under the threshold once the tentacle swings stop.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 are skill and it's all about the tentacles: Illaoi's Tentacle Smash (W) and Harsh Lesson (E) out-trade you and her passive sustain refills whatever your P Silver Stake chips away. Dodge her Test of Spirit skillshot, poke when tentacles are on cooldown, and don't get greedy in melee.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 are skill and it's all about the tentacles: Tentacle Smash (Q) and Harsh Lesson (W) out-trade you, and every tentacle that lands on a champion heals her, so bring Grievous Wounds. Dodge Test of Spirit (E, 900 range), poke off the tentacles, and don't get greedy in melee.

edits.before: At 6 you tip ahead. Her Leap of Faith (R) all-in is scary, but you have the mobility to E out of the tentacle field, then re-engage and execute her under Purgatory (R) once the slams stop. Bait her E, W for grey-health, and finish between windows. Levels 4-5 stay a skill lane about spacing the tentacles.
edits.after: Level 6 is even, not yours. Leap of Faith grounds you — Ashen Pursuit will not fire while you stand in it, so the plan is to be outside the 450 radius before she slams, never to dash out after. Bait her E, W for grey-health, and execute between tentacle swings. Levels 4-5 stay a skill lane about spacing.

edits.before: With items it's roughly even. Illaoi's R field wins any stand-still brawl, but your E blink lets you fight her outside the tentacles and execute a target with no dash to chase you. Never all-in into a fresh R.
edits.after: With items it's roughly even. Illaoi's R field wins any stand-still brawl and grounds your blink inside it, so fight her outside the tentacles and execute a target with no dash to chase you. Never all-in into a fresh R.

edits.before: Use E to escape her Leap of Faith (R)
edits.after: Leave before Leap of Faith grounds you

edits.before: Track Illaoi’s Test of Spirit: Dodging the spirit pull is the entire matchup. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1, 900 range: dodge the pull or kill the spirit before you become a Vessel.

notes: The page's mid-game plan was 'E out of her ult', and Leap of Faith grounds — Ashen Pursuit does not fire inside it. That single omission made the level-6 row wrong in both layers and the advice actively lethal. Slots for Tentacle Smash and Harsh Lesson were also swapped throughout.
